meta.title: Computer History MCP
meta.description: Local encrypted desktop history control panel and scoped MCP client token manager.

ui.appSubtitle: Local encrypted desktop history & scoped MCP access
ui.autoRefreshFailed: Auto-refresh failed; retrying on next tick
ui.copyFailed: Copy failed; select and copy manually
ui.authDesc: Open the local login URL printed in the terminal by `computer-history-mcp serve`, or paste the token from `admin.token` in your data directory.
ui.reloadCollectorResumed: Collector reloaded and resumed with the current capture scope.
ui.permissionsDesc: macOS requires Accessibility to read focused UI elements and Input Monitoring for optional keyboard/pointer event capture.
ui.storageUninitialized: Encryption key or segment store has not been initialized yet.
ui.scopeCardDesc: Changes apply the next time capture starts (or click Apply & Restart while running).
ui.scope_window: Active window (visible text and layout bounds)
ui.chBrowser: Browser page content (non-excluded browsers in denylist mode)
ui.chAxCompat: Editor AX compatibility (enable accessibility for VSCode / Antigravity)
ui.chTextMarkers: Text marker ranges (AXTextMarker queries for rich documents)
ui.chSelection: Text selection (highlighted selections in active surface)
ui.chInputText: Typed input text (committed keyboard chunks; requires Input Monitoring)
ui.chInputActivity: Coarse input activity (1s click, scroll, drag, shortcut counts)
ui.chMenuActions: Foreground menu bar commands (selected top menu paths, excluding Apple menu)
ui.security_strict: Strict (also block fields without explicit security metadata)
ui.mode_denylist: Denylist — capture all apps except listed
ui.mode_allowlist: Allowlist — capture only listed apps (browser capture off)
ui.allowlistEmptyError: Enter at least one valid bundle ID in allowlist mode.
ui.mandatoryExclusionsDesc: Always blocked before any Accessibility query or input tap, regardless of user configuration:
ui.adaptersDesc: Registered native Collector adapters matched by bundle ID before falling back to Generic.
ui.adapterFallbackAll: Default fallback for all unmatched applications
ui.mcpCreateDesc: Issue a scoped token for an external AI client (Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor). Plaintext tokens are shown once upon creation.
ui.scopeReadLabel: read — query status, search, read text, and inspect window layout
ui.scopePauseLabel: pause — allow the agent to pause active capture
ui.scopeReloadLabel: reload — allow the agent to hot-reload the collector or restart the daemon (never starts stopped capture)
ui.tokenCreatedNotice: Copy your MCP configuration now. Only the SHA-256 digest is stored on disk.
ui.leasesEmpty: No MCP client tokens issued yet.
ui.forgetNotice: Deleted segments are permanently removed from disk. Deleting local history cannot recall text already read by an external AI model.
